arguments.content: Receipt protocol rollout: a client unit test updated to return a future provider receipt can conceal a false failure after a successful remote write. In enhanced-settings task 1, running both clients against eval-release:provider/settings.py showed that HEAD returned success, while the staged client raised for missing applied after the same settings had already been stored. The provider ignores require_receipt and returns only ok. For independently released client/provider changes, verify both committed effects and the caller's result against the supported provider; changing only the mock is not compatibility evidence. Preserve legacy response acceptance for ordinary saves and enforce receipts only on a supported or negotiated path.
